question: In October 2020, investment promotion and facilitation agency Guidance partnered with World Economic Forum (WEF) to establish India’s first advanced manufacturing hub (AMHUB) in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On October 7, 2020, Guidance, a nodal investment promotion and facilitation agency of Tamilnadu (TN) located in Chennai joined hands with the World Economic Forum (WEF) to** set up India's and South Asia's first advanced manufacturing hub (AMHUB) in Tamil Nadu.**
